mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and a drop in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO falls below 115.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, which typically triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to the inflation news.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 190.0 for three consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which typically leads to a delayed negative S&P 500 return over the next 60 trading days as the Federal Reserve delays rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 190.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 1750.0 for two consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, which typically drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST exceeds 1750.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 132000.0 for two consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate hiring slows and economic growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS falls below 132000.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
